title: Year 4 full-year spelling check (30 words)
subject: English
source: Written for english/y4 lesson 99 (Year 4 full-year spelling check: 30 words in sentences (teacher-written from the Year 3 and 4 patterns and statutory list; in the portal and printable))
intro: Lesson 99. Listen to each word in a sentence. Write the word.

blocks.answers: 1 invention; 2 discussion; 3 magician; 4 division; 5 television; 6 famous; 7 dangerous; 8 unhappy; 9 disagree; 10 misbehave; 11 antiseptic; 12 international; 13 superstar; 14 treasure; 15 measure; 16 chef; 17 scheme; 18 league; 19 accident; 20 believe; 21 breathe; 22 calendar; 23 certain; 24 different; 25 experience; 26 favourite; 27 guard; 28 important; 29 minute; 30 surprise

blocks.note: Teacher reads each word, then the sentence, then the word again: 1 invention: The telephone was a great invention. 2 discussion: We had a discussion in class. 3 magician: The magician did a trick. 4 division: We practised division. 5 television: The television was off. 6 famous: The geyser is famous. 7 dangerous: The ice was dangerous. 8 unhappy: He felt unhappy. 9 disagree: I disagree with you. 10 misbehave: Do not misbehave. 11 antiseptic: Put antiseptic on the cut. 12 international: It was an international match. 13 superstar: She is a superstar. 14 treasure: They found treasure. 15 measure: Measure the table. 16 chef: The chef cooked rice. 17 scheme: We joined the reading scheme. 18 league: Our team won the league. 19 accident: It was an accident. 20 believe: I believe you. 21 breathe: Breathe slowly. 22 calendar: Check the calendar. 23 certain: Are you certain? 24 different: Each leaf is different. 25 experience: It was a good experience. 26 favourite: My favourite fruit is mango. 27 guard: The guard stood still. 28 important: This is important. 29 minute: Wait a minute. 30 surprise: What a surprise!
